address: 7540 Hasentree Club DR, Wake Forest, NC 27587
description: Situated on just over an acre in the highly sought-after Hasentree community, this 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home blends luxury, functionality, and privacy. Two dedicated home offices, two spacious bonus rooms, a generous mudroom, and a well-appointed laundry room offer flexibility for remote work, hobbies, fitness, or media space. The open floor plan suits both everyday living and entertaining, while the 3-car garage provides abundant storage. A low-maintenance Trex deck overlooks a private, partially wooded backyard — a peaceful setting for morning coffee or outdoor dining. Hasentree is one of Wake Forest's premier golf course communities, offering a Tom Fazio golf course, clubhouse, pools, tennis and pickleball courts, a fitness center, and walking trails.
